summary: galaxy takes a requirements.yml file, dict or string; python takes a file or list merged across collections by requirements-parser, excluding test and Ansible packages (EXCLUDE_REQUIREMENTS, overridable with introspect --user-pip); python_interpreter and bindep system packages are also set here.
questions: Why did ansible-builder skip a Python package my collection needs?
How do I set the Python interpreter in an execution environment?
What format do system dependencies use in ansible-builder?
